verdict.rationale: Vercel documents an official CLI for deploying from the terminal: install it, run `vercel login`, then run `vercel`. The getting-started guide describes deploying in three CLI-driven steps, and access tokens authenticate the CLI for automated, dashboard-free use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI deploys, detailed documentation of CLI deploy options such as production promotion flags

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote:
npm i -g vercel
vercel login
vercel
Deploy your app on Vercel in three steps: install the CLI, add agent support if you use an AI coding agent, and deploy.
Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI.
With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
